title: What did I pay for???
text: My daughter really wants to help in the kitchen so I thought what a great idea to give her inspo each month but this box is literally a glorified recipe sheet and nothing more. You get 3 recipes and some sort of kitchen tool each month that you can find for a buck and that's it. Literally, that's all you get. Massive face palm. No idea how this business is so popular other than maybe fooling unsuspecting parents?
label: negative
